field_principles.accuracy_forward_transfer_retention_and_: Reports per-family and per-arm forward transfer, protected retention, negative transfer, and confidence intervals.
field_principles.arm_definitions_and_resource_parity: Defines the four matched arms and proves equal event order, decision counts, seeds, storage budget, and metric surfaces.
field_principles.block_end_consolidation_log: Shows slow consolidation publishes staged constraints only after each family block ends.
field_principles.continuous_learning_promotion_ready_scor: Uses a conjunctive promotion gate that fails if any protected gate fails.
field_principles.continuous_self_learning_task: Bare true marks this as the FR-11 continuous self-learning task.
field_principles.decision_time_write_count: Bare zero proves no memory write occurred during a decision.
field_principles.duration_s: Records measured wall-clock time for deterministic replay.
field_principles.field_principles: Echoes these field principles into the artifact for audit.
field_principles.field_provenance: Maps each required field to Exp6145 replay, preregistration, arm run, verifier, attack, rollback, or test evidence.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Starts with `complete:`, `complete_null:`, or `blocked:` and states the temporal-learning result.
field_principles.immediate_commit_log: Shows verified immediate commits become visible only to later events.
field_principles.immutable_predecision_snapshot_hashes: Records read-only pre-event snapshots for every arm decision and proves no current outcome was visible.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Declares deterministic exact-verifier replay with external memory and no LLM.
field_principles.model_weight_mutation_count: Bare zero proves no mutable model weights were used or updated.
field_principles.poison_injection_results: Proves malformed, poisoned, duplicate, reordered, and stale events fail closed with zero poison propagation.
field_principles.post_outcome_event_and_verifier_receipts: Records exact Exp6145 Python/Z3 verifier receipts after outcome disclosure.
field_principles.preregistered_chronological_family_block: Freezes family blocks, held future IDs, seeds, memory budget, metrics, and promotion gates before arm execution.
field_principles.procedural_constraint_schema: Defines provenance, scope, support, TTL, verifier receipt, and source event hash for promoted constraints.
field_principles.promoted_quarantined_rejected_and_rolled: Counts accepted, quarantined, rejected, duplicate, stale, and rollback outcomes.
field_principles.protected_files_unchanged: Proves conductor, ops, traceability, and Exp6145 upstream artifacts stayed byte-identical.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hashes the artifact with the checksum field normalized.
field_principles.rollback_exactness: Proves atomic rollback restores active store and decision trace hashes to the pre-run baseline.
field_principles.shuffled_memory_receipt: Uses the same promoted-record budget with deliberately broken family alignment as a control.
field_principles.status: Terminal state follows the frozen Exp6145 stream, arm parity, promotion gates, attack handling, rollback, protected-file, and test receipts.
field_principles.test_commands: Lists focused, coverage, full-suite, spec, adversarial, and command-line checks.
field_principles.test_exit_codes: Records exit codes so failed checks cannot be reported as success.
field_principles.train_eval_overlap_count: Bare zero proves calibration IDs and held evaluation IDs are disjoint.
field_principles.update_utility_and_memory_cost: Reports update utility, record counts, byte cost, and utility per record under the shared memory budget.
field_principles.upstream_stream_path_hash_and_clean_rece: Hashes the Exp6145 artifact, row, split, and outcome sidecars and records the clean oracle-separation replay.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Records that the post-outcome verifier is exact while decisions remain pre-outcome.
